{mx:site_faq_1_q}How much does a roof repair cost?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_1_a}Most repairs fall between $350 and $1,500 depending on access and materials. We give you a fixed written price before any work starts, so there are no surprises.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_2_q}How quickly can you come out?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_2_a}We usually inspect within 1 to 2 business days, and same day for active leaks and storm damage.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_3_q}Are you licensed and insured?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_3_a}Yes. We hold a current QBCC licence and full public liability insurance, and we are happy to send certificates before we start.{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_4_q}Do you offer a guarantee?{/mx}

{mx:site_faq_4_a}Every job comes with our 10-year workmanship guarantee on top of the manufacturer warranty on materials.{/mx}

Home / Privacy policy

Privacy policy

This policy explains how {{ custom_values.business_name }} (ABN {{ custom_values.site_abn }}) collects, uses and protects your personal information in line with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles.

What we collect

When you request a quote, book a job or contact us, we collect the details you give us, such as your name, phone number, email, address and information about the job. Our website also records basic technical information such as pages visited and the type of device used.

How we use it

  • To respond to your enquiry, prepare quotes and carry out work
  • To send appointment reminders, job updates and, after a job, a request to review our service
  • To improve our website and services

We will only send marketing messages if you have agreed to receive them, and every message includes a way to opt out. You can reply STOP to any text message or use the unsubscribe link in any email.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your information. We share it only with service providers who help us run the business, such as our customer management, messaging and payment platforms, and only so they can provide those services. Some of these providers may store data outside Australia.

Keeping it safe

We take reasonable steps to protect your information from misuse, loss and unauthorised access, and we delete or de-identify it when it is no longer needed.

Access, correction and complaints

You can ask to see or correct the information we hold about you, or make a privacy complaint, by emailing {{ custom_values.site_email }} or calling {{ custom_values.site_phone_display }}. We will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.
